subject: general
question: Mr. Z starts from Point A and drives 13 km towards the South. He then takes a left turn, drives 15 km, then turns left and drives 27 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 31 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 14 km, and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only, unless specified.)
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given:

Mr. Z starts at Point A (0, 0)
13 km South
15 km East (left from South)
27 km North
31 km West
14 km South

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f66f4aeb992c2cdd6fc89c2b40a5aec79c2f6b7a4fedf2ffbf0a36e39b9e9ce7.png] 

So To reach Point A again from P: Move 16 km East

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 1**.
